title: UIBC revocation delta report line
description: One line of a JSON Lines file produced by `uibc_core.pyz verify-revocation-delta --report`. It carries the decision, the position in the chain the reader stopped on when it refused, and — on an acceptance — the head a reader would pin next and the sequence number it reached. A head on a refusal would name a list that was never installed, which is the exact confusion this format exists to prevent. The exit code follows the suite's contract: 0 accept, 1 reject, 3 unreadable suite or chain.

vector.description: The suite case (RL01 to RL52 in the shared vectors) or the chain document this line is about.

result.description: PASS only for `accept`; FAIL for any `reject`, whichever rule produced it; ERROR when the suite or chain could not be read. PASS means the fold agrees with the answer key, never that a chain is trustworthy.

decision.description: null only on an ERROR line. A refusal is the reader's statement that it did not install the list.

reason.description: `in_force` on an acceptance; one of the suite's ten refusing tokens otherwise: revocation_list_shape, revocation_list_signer_not_a_root, revocation_list_signature_unverified, revocation_list_other_chain, revocation_list_rollback, revocation_list_gap, revocation_list_previous_mismatch, revocation_list_time_reversed, revocation_entry_from_future, revocation_entry_repeated.

index.description: The position in the chain, counting from zero, at which the reader refused. Null on an acceptance and on an ERROR line: a chain that holds has no position to stop at.

head.description: The digest of the list in force after the fold — `sha256:` plus lowercase hex of the RFC 8785 form of its body. Null on a refusal: nothing was installed.

seq.description: The sequence number reached by the fold. Null on a refusal, for the same reason as head.

exit.description: The suite's contract: 0 for accept, 1 for reject, 3 for a suite or chain that could not be read. A refusal never exits 0.

error.description: Present only on an ERROR line, and required there.

$comment: Cross-field rules the subset here cannot express: PASS iff decision is accept, reason is in_force, index is null, head and seq are present, and exit is 0; FAIL iff decision is reject, reason is one of the ten refusing tokens, index is a non-negative integer, head and seq are null, and exit is 1; ERROR iff decision, reason, index, head and seq are all null, an error string is present, and exit is 3.
